properties.title: Bonaire mangrove and vegetated wetland
properties.source: OpenStreetMap natural=wetland ways and relations, retrieved 2026-10-05 via Overpass.
properties.method: Kept: wetland=mangrove, swamp, marsh, saltmarsh, reedbed or wet_meadow. Left out: seagrass beds, tidal flats, salt pans and untagged wetland. The season runner buffers these polygons and removes them from the water side before classifying. Built by scripts/make_island_segments.py.
